justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/TypeResolutionStrategy.java` (267 lines) and `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/TypeResolutionStrategyTest.java`. The target is a small strategy family: one top-level interface with one method (`resolve()`), one nested `Resolved` interface, and four focused implementations (`Passive`, `Active`, `Lazy`, `Disabled`) whose methods each cover a single concern (`injectedInto`/`initialize`). The tests exercise each variant separately, which supports cohesive, separated responsibilities rather than an under-decomposed class.
